nom: Peach Slices Redness Relief Azelaic Acid Serum

avis.texte: Absolutely love this product! I have type two rosacea and struggle with a lot of texture on my cheeks, but this product helped both the redness AND texture. I have tried other azelaic acids before like the one from the ordinary, but unfortunately, those just left me with more closed comodones on my face. 10/10!!!! And great price point too

…but for this product I absolutely had to. I have repurchased this product no less than 5 times with my own hard earned coin, and i will continue to repurchase as long as this formula stays the same. IT IS WORTH EVERY PENNY. I have tried MANY different azaleic acid treatments and this one absolutely takes the cake. Not only did my skin clear up with consistent use, it also helped fade my post acne marks that have been bothering me for YEARS. It also instantly reduced my redness (as someone who is pretty much always red)

This has multiple pore clogging incredients (you can check for yourself on the Acne Clinic NYC website) and broke me out very badly. So I don't recommend this for anyone who is acne-prone. However, it did show immediate results of reducing redness, so if you have rosacea maybe it would be a good fit? But the immediate redness relief was negated by the horrible acne I got from this 😂 So again, not a good acne treatment.
This serum and along with the soothing serum are excellent. Reduces the redness and hydrating for skin. Worth buying together.
This product cleared up my hormonal chin breakouts in 1 day after using anua for 3 weeks and no results.

avis.titre: Not good for acne prone skin
avis.texte: My skin hated this product. After application it would make me itch so badly, and it stayed greasy on the skin. I did a patch test and it was fine, but when i used it on all of my face, I had to immediately wash my face. It did the opposite of its name.
I love this serum! It reduced redness, cleared up the breakouts, and evened out the texture of my skin; it looks clearer and calmer now than it has in years!
I bought this after recommendation by esthetician for my rosacea. I haven't noticed much of a difference yet
This is a new addition to my skincare routine, but so far I'm loving it!! I can definitely see a difference in my redness already and I can't wait to see the long term use results

avis.titre: Great for skin with rosacea issues!
avis.texte: Started using Peach Slices Redness Relief, Peach Slices Redness Relief Azelaic Acid Serum, Peach Slices Redness Relief Calming Cream, and Cetaphil Sun 50 Sheer Mineral Sunscreen Face Drops for all skin types about a year ago. I layer them onto my face in that order all at the same time before putting on my other skin sensitive facial makeup. It has worked significantly in keeping my face free from rosacea flareups. Make sure to keep the products out of your eyes due to irritation. Great products!

I couldn't figure out why my makeup started to look terrible. It would look splotchy and it would pill really badly. I finally remembered that I added this to my morning routine. Once I took it out, my makeup started looking great again. Even when I tried using it at night, if I didn't wash my face in the morning before adding my skin care, my makeup would look terrible. I also didn't notice a difference in the redness of my skin.
I have re-purchased a couple tubes of this Azelaic acid as it is helpful in soothing and reducing redness when my skin is having rosacea flair up.

Lightweight and very fluid texture but I really like that and I tried a lot of different Azelac Acid serums and this one, is one of the best if not the best My Rosacea never flares up with this Highly recommended and would purchase again

I usually don't write reviews but I have to let y'all know, this BURNS. My skin needs lots of healing after this product. Please stay away.

Love having this to calm my skin in the morning for a less red face all day long!
It is works very well. Helped my skin stop acne and helped the redness i have in my cheeks be less prevalent.

I bought this as it was recommended as a more affordable alternative to the Il Makiage camo corrector for redness. I love the Il Makiage cream, so i was excited to try this. Within 1 minute of putting it on, my skin was burning—and i mean it felt like i was putting my face in a pizza oven. I rinsed it off fast, but it left me with chemical burns covering my entire face. Worst. Product. Ever.

avis.titre: Only Azelaic acid that has worked for me
avis.texte: I have tried all of the recommended azelaic acids for my skin. I have rosacea and very reactive skin and this seems to calm my skin. Every one I have tried has irritated me and has not worked. Highly recommend.
I use this on my forehead only and it's completely eliminated all the little bumps and texture from my forhead. Ive been batteling for a longggg time!

I received this product in a gratis at Ulta and it's worked so well for me, I needed to leave a review. I have very sensitive and dry skin. I've previously been "training" my skin with Naturium's azaleic acid emulsion, so I wasn't at all sensitive to this product. I combined it with Naturium's Multi-Bright Milky toner and Naturium's Multi-peptide moisturizer and my skin is LOVING it. I used this cream after toner and before moisturizer and have noticed the redness from my acne scars is significantly lighter. My skin feels and looks hydrated. I'm not 100% sure if it's the combination of all three products, or if this one is the magic one, but I do see a huge improvement in my skin's texture and appearance after starting this one.

avis.titre: didn't really think it would work lol
avis.texte: I wanted to try a 10% Azelaic acid for acne treatment. Didn't do much for my acne, but I figured I might as well use the rest of the bottle. After 3-4 weeks I looked in the mirror & realized my post-acne marks had actually faded! Shocked but pleased.
Made my skin really itchy when combined with the peach slices snail mucin set. I'm almost done with the bottle and notice no difference in my redness.

I have been dealing with redness on chin, nose, and cheeks due to over exfoliating. I began to use this in combination with more hyaluronic acid and a heavier moisturizer, and saw reduced redness and irritation.
Love this serum! It's so smooth and creamy and great on sensitive skin. Definitely a repurchase. Also, love the fact it's made with clean, safe ingredients!
I've been using it every other day for the last two weeks to get my skin used to it, and I've already seen a massive difference to the redness of my cheek.
I find so few products actually do what they say but this absolutely does help clear my skin and reduce redness. I only wish it came in a bigger tube!
I have tried several different Azalaic Acid Serums and this is definitely the best! It feels like light and not sticky once applied AND resolves any breakouts and random skin irritations I may have!
Cleared up my skin and reduces redness from PIE soooo much. I genuinely have not used a product that has calmed my skin down so much without irritating it

I never write reviews but because this worked so well I felt like I needed to. I genuinely said "wow" after using it twice and seeing the results. Got rid of my red discoloration and hyperpigmentation.
I use this daily. I find it has really helped with redness. Highly recommend!

I got this serum because I heard azelaic acid was great for reducing redness and I had some bad redness on my chin and around my nose. i used the serum twice a day and I already noticed a visible improvement after only one week of using it. It also helped reduce the number of blackheads and whiteheads on my nose and chin.

One of the best azelaic acid products I've used. I started seeing a difference in my skin right away and it's one of the only products that controls my rosacea pustules without causing irritation or dryness.
Felt nice going on and not even a few seconds later my entire face started burning so bad. I immediately rinsed it off. Left me a nice chemical burn all over my chin….

I use azalaic acid daily, i normally use Naturium, also tried Anua but i wanted to try something new. Im used to the way AA feels, but this one gave me a rash and made my skin so itchy. Never experienced this with AA. Unfortunately use at your own risk!

avis.titre: I'm so happy with the Azelaic Acid
avis.texte: I am from Nigeria. When I saw testimony online on this product, I had to find all means to purchase it at USA. Within 2 weeks of using, my face looking like a teenager. Thank you peach and lily

I've struggled with redness on my face my entire life. I suspect I might have rosacea, but I haven't been to the dermatologist yet to confirm. I decided to research what skincare ingredients might help with that and came across azelaic acid. So I decided to give this product a go and.... DUDE. I am insanely impressed. This is the first time I've experienced almost immediate results with a skincare product. Like literally I applied it before bed, and the next morning the redness on my face calmed down SO much. I've never seen my skin so even looking. I have very sensitive skin that's prone to breaking out and dryness, and this product has been really gentle and nondrying. I've only been using for a few weeks now about every other day, so I'm not sure about long term effects yet. But the short term effects have been incredible. This is a new staple in my routine.

For context, I am 43 and have extremely dry skin that is constantly red. This product made a significant and immediate improvement in redness. My only criticism is that you definitely need to use a moisturizer on top, otherwise it will dry out your face.

My skin texture improved rapidly in the matter of days and by week 2 it was at a smoothness I couldn't have imagined without procedures done. The amount is barely enough for a month if you follow the directions of applying twice a day however.

not bad, but better options exist. inkey list specifically worked better for me. like all azelaic, if youre sensitive be sure to wait and apply to completely dry skin or it will burn. (i tend to use a milky toner after cleansing and then wait a few minutes to apply an acid). and even on dry skin, might be an adjustment period.

I bought this AA because it was the only one i found without niacinamide (my skin reacts to it). The purge only lasted 7-10 days. I was getting pimples with white heads and I never get that kind of pimples. After that i didnt get breakouts anymore but my skin was very dry. I stopped using it after a month just because I've got prescription azelaic from my dermatologist, i feel like using this one first made the transition smoother and my skin is loving the prescription one.
My skin is extremely sun sensitive and I use this at night to reduce redness along with a daily high spf sunscreen.

really know your skin, but i am someone who has hormanal acne due to PCOS, im very pale and when i get any cyst acne or just regular acne i do tend to get red, ive tried this producy for 3-4 days and ive seen the differance how toned down the redness has become. i did put this on morning and night. i didnt get any bad reaction after 24 hours or instant. so far i like it its really good.

I bought this as a last resort because I was so fet up with my acne and I saw online that this could potentially help. It was the best thing I ever purchased. I went from having a ton of raised acne and blackheads to so much improvement. My skin isn't totally clear but I am on the way there!!! I highly recommend this product if you're struggling with acne and redness it definitely helped my situation!!
I absolutely love this product in helping to control redness and blemishes. So many freat brodcts from this brand and their sister brand!

avis.titre: This had as much impact as water on my skin
avis.texte: This did nothing for me at all. Nothing for redness or sensitivity or hydration. It felt like just some generic cream. It gave me a very strong burning sensation on my skin after applying it. :( I don't think this is going to work for me for long term use. Once I washed the product off, my skin calmed down and no more burning prickly sensation.

Redness Relief Azelaic Acid Serum worked. I had used a soap that messed up my skin barrier this product along with Avene Cicalfate restorative protective cream broght my skin back to the way it was. If this happened to you buy two bc it takes a while.

It's a very effective azelaic cream. I have sensitive redness probe skin and it worked well.

My Dermatologist prescribed me 15% azeleic acid cream for dry patches on my face. My script ran out and I haven't seen him in years. I've since tried some otc versions at 12% and 10%. I was hoping this would help with the dryness and redness. It isn't doing anything for redness, which I'm not surprised. I'm still getting dryness in certain areas late afternoon and upon waking.
I tried using this for my rosacea like it says it works for. Made me break out horribly and did not reduce redness.
gave me horrible blackheads all over my face. it was the only new product during that time. do not recommend. only figured out thanks to another review

I've been using this every other day for over two weeks now. My skin texture is generally good so I am mostly using azelaic acid as a preventative for uneven skintone. I've noticed the reddish area around my nose is slightly less red, but it may be too soon to tell if there have been any other significant changes. My skin tends to be sensitive to heavy cream or oily skincare formulas. I find this very easy to spread(dont have to use too much) and have had no breakouts. In the first two weeks, my skin tingled/felt itchy for about an hour after application(My skin did not feel tight or inflamed during this time though) The tingly feeling went away after consistent use and if used on dry skin vs damp. I also use hydrating toners after application

avis.titre: I wouldn't recommend to ppl with sensitive skin!
avis.texte: Typically I'm not a review writer but this product genuinely damamged my skin barrier like none other. I've only ever had my skin barrier damanged one other time by a cleanser I was trying out but that was not nearly as awful as this treatment. I started with it in the P.M. and then the following morning used it in the A.M. I have never witnessed my face get so mad and irritated by one product. It made my face turn red and get weltish looking dots around the entirety of my face. It took about an hour to finally calm down but since then, my skin texture hasn't been the same. It is very clear how damaged my skin barrier is by touch. The other time this happened to me my barrier healed after about 2 weeks and my skin was back to normal. I'm just hoping that is the same with this situation and that I didn't permanently damage it. Mind you, I should have done more research on this product especially knowing I have very sensitive skin. That is completely my wrong doing. I'm sure this works for many, just not my skin type! Figured I would write this to give us sensitive skin types a fair warning.
I love this preparation simple mostly active with soothing agents added in. Good easy to apply texture and affordable !
This series works great for me, helps nullify redness from rosacea

I like the consistency of the serum. I've only used it once, but it seems to work well.

My skin looks worse since using this so I have to go back to my previous brand.

Please don't ever stop making this! I've noticed a huge difference in my skin with it and absolutely love it. I think it's made a huge difference with hormonal acne as well as overall redness. Thank you!!

Like another reviewer, I've used The Ordinary Azelaic Suspension and it never irritated my skin but the texture was so thick so I wanted to try something else. This one was very irritating. It was on for less then 5 minutes and I had to wash it off.

This is my first time ever posting a review on the internet because I must share my praises for this product. So, I have been struggling with rosacea/acne/scarring for 2 years. Tried several dermatologist prescribed treatments (topicals, antibiotics) without any long term success. Extremely sensitive, painful, and highly reactive skin. Nothing ever worked, it was very frustrating, and basically I came to terms that my skin would never heal or be clear again. I picked up this product on a whim. After 2 DAYS of using this product, my redness SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCED and rosacea began to HEAL!!! I use this at night only after cleansing with Vanicream and before moistourizer La Roche Posay. I am now almost out, and this *AFFORDABLE* product has healed my troubled skin and effectively managed my rosacea. No more antibiotics or other derm solutions needed. I never thought this would be possible. I can now go bare-faced and have regained my confidence. I so wish i had known about this sooner. If your situation is similar, and you have rosacea/acne and nothing is working, please do consider trying this product.
Amazing, cleared up my eye dermatitis when nothing else worked. So happy with this product.

AM Routine: BPO cleanser, toner mist, Azelaic acid (this product), spot treatment, moisturizer, wait 5m, SPF 33 F Asian-American oil acne prone skin in a dry and high sun climate. This serum works well for me. Doesn't pill. Straight forward packaging and use. Wish this came in a more environmentally thoughtful package, like 100 post-consumer plastic, and/or glass. But the product itself is great for me.

I have pretty significant rosacea in my cheeks and I have noticed a difference since starting to use this product. I do use it in the morning before makeup and at night as a step in my nightime routine. The redness isnt completely gone but I do find myself going out sometimes without makeup and thats somethjng I would have never done before. It really has been a game changer for me!

avis.titre: Great option to test out AzA
avis.texte: If you want a gentle beginners Azelaic Acid product this is a good one. It does pill under other skincare/makeup though so give it a good while before putting anything on over the top. Calms redness down a little, doesn't feel cloying or sticky on my oily/combo skin but also doesn't dry me out.
It needs to be used consistently but it definitely helps reduce redness.

avis.titre: Not for Me – No Noticeable Effects, but Unsure on Redness Re
avis.texte: Since I don't struggle with redness, I can't comment on whether this product effectively reduces it. Unfortunately, I haven't noticed any other benefits either—it hasn't made any visible difference to my skin, positive or negative. It might work better for someone with redness concerns, but for me, it just didn't seem to do anything at all. It's a neutral product in my experience, so I wouldn't call it a game-changer or particularly recommend it for general use.

avis.titre: I find this to be a very good value
avis.texte: I apply this at night with some vit c serum & lotion. It doesn't seem to peel as other Azelaic acid formulations do. It's not as cheap as some that peel bad, but it's not as expensive as others. On on my 2nd tube of this product and I like it well.

avis.titre: Almost as good as prescription AzA!
avis.texte: This is such a great OTC azelaic acid product—its almost as effective as the prescription-strength gel I've used, and so much cheaper and more accessible. Clears acne, reduces redness, and with far fewer side effects than salicylic acid. I highly recommend!

This is the first redness specific product I've ever tried. It felt good on my face when I applied it (1-3 times weekly) but I'm near the end of the tube and I don't think it has done much for my complexion. It hasn't done anything for my redness.
It's OK, skin feels smooth after using. Don't see much difference and redness.

I've used different products to try to tone down my red skin, but nothing has ever seemed to work—but this product actually seems to be working! My redness isn't *gone*, but when I use this at night, I really see a difference in the morning. I'm so happy I gave this a try!

Bought this blindly in replace of my favorite TULA product thinking I was saving money, I was not. As someone with dry skin it made me face drier than usual, made my face tingle and burn after use and skin around eyes are also irritated. DO NOT RECOMMEND.

I have acne and i'm always looking for products that reduce the redness and acne. This product does it the best. Its my second to last skincare step and it works perfectly under primers and makeup. It actually helps with my breakouts and makes the skin calm down.

avis.titre: Decent AA at a good price point
avis.texte: It's not bad! Looking for a less expensive alt to another favorite brand. Lightweight gel cream texture that feels good and absorbs well. Not enough time to see results so I'll update my review. Looking for a reduction of redness from dryness/sensitivity/environmental (not rosacea).

I sometimes deal with red flushing across my face and this has really helped. I've noticed that I flush significantly less when I use this regularly. It's gentle enough to use twice a day and it doesn't really have a smell. It doesn't pill with my other skincare or with makeup.

avis.titre: Glad I randomly found this item!!
avis.texte: I can't stand putting anything greasy or sticky on my face and this is neither!! You can't even feel it on your face. It does help with redness better than other more expensive products I've used as well. Will repurchase!!
Fantastic for minimizing pores and reducing redness. Whenever I have little breakouts from my rosacea, it makes them go away very quickly. I will buy this forever
This cream is everything to me! My skin was red, dry and cracked at the corner of my lips and down to my chin. This cleared it up within two days! I will forever sing this product's praises!
Works fine, no weird texting from my skin or anything, but this far pretty equivalent to other similar products.

An absolutely fantastic product that does exactly what it says and more. Very pleasant texture that spreads and absorbs easily. I had no new breakouts since started using this, it's been over a month now AND I had my period in the meantime! My acne marks are fading fast, my skin is smoother and appears brighter, I can even go out makeup-free nowdays!!! I have combo skin, but I imagine it's suitable for all skin types since its texture is not drying nor oily. Definitely worth the money and I will repurchase soon ;)

avis.titre: Did not work for my teenage son
avis.texte: My son has been battling with acne for few years, we've tried EVERYTHING. The Peach Slices Redness Relief Azelaic Acid did not work for him after 3 weeks into using. The redness is still visible from his acne. Visit a dermatologist 💯

I incorporated this serum into my skincare routine and did not see any improvements on my skin. It also burned my face when I wore my moisturizer on top of it. The Azelaic Acid from The Ordinary works better, it calms my rosacea, and its gentler on the skin. Needless to say, I won't be repurchasing this one.

I have moderate rosacea with papules and I have tried everything under the sun to get it under control. I had good luck with the ordinary azelaic acid for a while, but I think they changed the formula. I was breaking out and having ruddiness despite using it consistently. I tried this and already my skin looks so much better. The spots are gone. The uneven, thickened texture is diminishing. The redness is basically gone. I am so glad I tried this on a whim.

My skin was going through it! As a result I developed some type of dermatitis. Everything I used hurt or gave me more bumps. I simplified my skin care with a cleanser and moisturizer and put this on in between at night. Within 2 weeks, my skin was finally starting to clear up and my pores are looking so good after a month. I slowed this down to 2x/week now and will always keep this around if I need it! 5 stars!
This is super helpful for people with sensitive skin and acne, I don't have rosacea, but this product has been amazing for my skin. It is amazing for people with and without rosacea!
I have Perioral Dermatitis and thought this product would help alot. It actually made my skin worse. It is super itchy and it burns. I woul not recommend this product.

I tried it once and it made my skin itch. I thought it was the combination of products. I tried it again on its own, and it made my skin burn. It doesn't help with redness, it just makes my skin feel terrible.

Gonna start off by prefacing I gave 4 stars because I haven't used this product long term. I have had some sort of redness with bumps for 9 months and have tried sulfur treatments, snail mucin, and other k-beauty products. Almost everything I put on my skin leads to red bumps on my cheek, nose, and upper lip area. My skin gets more irritated by heat so this summer has not been fun. I think I have rosacea type 2, but I havent been to a derm. I've only been using this for about a week and a half. I use it once a day, at night time. I use a cetaphil cleanser for combination skin with the Avene cicalfate moisturizer- that's it. I would recommend getting a good moisturuzer that repairs skin barriers and is very soothing because this product does cause some irritation for me. I layer the product all over after my skin has dried from cleansing. Once the azealic acid has dried THEN i put on my moisturizer, I noticed that when I don't wait before that step I have more irritation. With the right routine, the results have been sooo good though, I have less red bumps and my skin has been the clearest since 2023. Rosacea and skin irritation is so difficult to deal with, but I would recommend at least trying peach slices azealic acid- and buying from ulta means you can always return :) ALSO, I have been using an acne spot treatment with benzyl peroxide with no issues, but I waited a few days after starting the Peach Slices before using the acne spot treatment.
It's supposed to help with redness. I'm still red after a couple of weeks.

avis.titre: Wish I Had Used This Sooner!
avis.texte: I was embarrassed and tired of people commenting on my skin. They would ask "what happened to your face?! It's so red, did you get a sunburn?" I would buy products that said they were calming but not specifically targeting rosacea. I started reading more about it and self diagnosed myself. Then started looking for products that were top rated for rosacea and found Peach Slices! I started off with their Azelaic Acid, honestly, I was thinking it might irritate my skin and could make my redness worst; but I was willing to take the risk. I started off with applying very little to see if my skin would freak out or react to it. So far, so good. It tingled a bit but nothing too crazy and after a few hours I looked in the mirror, to my surprise my skin looked visibly smoother and my redness had decreased (still there but not as bad). I continued using it and bought their soothing cleanser as well! Loving the cleanser too, first contact with my skin and it felt cooling and soothing! After using for about a week, my skin is looking so so good! Even my mom and co worker said they noticed the difference! I really wished I did my research sooner. A STAPLE! If I could only choose 1 skincare item I NEED, it might be this!!! I'm 41, & my skin is on the dry side, some hormonal ancne and it's suuuuper sensitive/reactive/allergies. I get flare-ups of perioral dermatitis & I heard azelaic acid might help with that so I went on the hunt for the perfect azelaic product! The ordinary one is fine but there's nothing extra. Then I got this gem. And man o man! I trained my skin to tolerate azelaic am/pm & I add a little glycolic/mandelic in the eve. But this is soooo soothing! I wish I had started with this one… the green color offers no redness correction, but it's seriously the best I've tried (I even tried Paula's Choice but my skin didn't like the salicylic in there)! AND I HAVENT HAD A PERIORAL DERMATITIS FLARE UP THIS YEAR! Coincidence? I think not!
